description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter named NavigationAdapter for rendering a horizontal navigation bar with multiple items. It manages item selection, focus states, and styling based on active/inactive states, responding to user interactions like clicks and DPAD navigation.

classes.name: NavigationAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a horizontal navigation menu with styled text and background that responds to user interactions and focus.

classes.name: NavigationAdapter.NavViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to the navigation item views and manages click events.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder, sets styles based on active state, and configures focusability.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of navigation items.
